assessment.review_notes: The authentic abstract reports alpha1(I) substitutions, dermal fibrils, mutant dimers and arterial rupture. Target structural biology is independently supported, while the source-specific vascular and identical-binding assertions remain undecided.

PMID:17217948.title: Inhibition of RhoA/Rho-kinase pathway suppresses the expression of type I collagen induced by TGF-beta2 in human retinal pigment epithelial cells.

assessment.review_notes: The actual abstract reports Rho/ROCK-dependent COL1A2 transcription and promoter response in human ARPE-19 cells. The full source remains unavailable; protein-performed signal-transduction evidence is unresolved, rather than categorically absent.

PMID:17334644.title: Association of gene polymorphisms with blood pressure and the prevalence of hypertension in community-dwelling Japanese individuals.

assessment.review_notes: The protected selected cache remains abstract-only, but the authentic complete original was recovered in an official Japanese grant-repository PDF (first nine physical pages; journal pages 675–683). ROOT read all nine pages as OCR and images; the owner independently read pages 1,2,4,6,8,9 OCR and viewed page 6/Table VIII. The positive nominal male blood-pressure association is preserved, with no significant male hypertension-prevalence or female BP association. The Discussion explicitly leaves molecular consequences unresolved and acknowledges linked variants/false positives. Identifier/title and original Table VIII agree; access is not inferred from the cache flag.

PMID:1740554.title: Expression of type I collagen pro-alpha 2 chain mRNA in adult human permanent teeth as revealed by in situ hybridization.

assessment.review_notes: The authentic abstract measures proalpha2(I) mRNA in adult human teeth/odontoblasts, including dentin formation near caries. It is expression evidence, not direct morphogenesis measurement; full text was not recovered.

PMID:17955022.title: Gene targeting of mutant COL1A2 alleles in mesenchymal stem cells from individuals with osteogenesis imperfecta.

assessment.review_notes: Actual selected full Methods/Results were read: human OI MSC allele targeting, collagen labeling/thermostability and bone-forming implants in immunodeficient mice. Several targeted clones form bone, including some with the wild-type allele targeted; avoid the earlier simplified claim of a uniform rescue outcome.

PMID:18375391.title: Defective C-propeptides of the proalpha2(I) chain of type I procollagen impede molecular assembly and result in osteogenesis imperfecta.

assessment.review_notes: The selected normal cache is abstract-only. The authentic original full source recovered in COL1A1-assembly-peer was reread in the bounded ROOT consultation: human alpha2 C-propeptide association/trimer incorporation, intrinsic assembly work and patient variants. This does not demonstrate a distinct adaptor mechanism or directly image fibril organization. Exact external source hash/paragraph scope is in the evidence index.

PMID:19932771.title: MMP-12 catalytic domain recognizes and cleaves at multiple sites in human skin collagen type I and type III.

assessment.review_notes: The authentic abstract explicitly reports MMP12 catalytic-domain recognition/cleavage of human skin type I collagen including alpha2 sites. This supports contextual substrate–protease association. The original full paper and exact isolated-chain binding boundaries were not recovered; the collagen is not assigned the protease activity.

PMID:20551380.title: Proteomics characterization of extracellular space components in the human aorta.

assessment.review_notes: Selected Methods/Results plus authentic original XML Table II target row86 were read. CO1A2_HUMAN appears in human aortic guanidine extract with 12 unique peptides, 15 unique spectra and 70 total spectra. This is matrix detection, not a direct tensile assay.

PMID:21362503.title: Protein profile of exosomes from trabecular meshwork cells.

assessment.review_notes: Selected body and separately retrieved authentic PMC Methods/Results/Table1 were read. COL1A2/P08123 normalized spectra are 96.4 in human TM-cell exosomes versus 1.7 in the urine comparison. Exosome-depleted medium, serial centrifugation and pellet washing support fraction association; target-specific lumen or marker-flotation localization was not shown. The earlier contamination dismissal is superseded.

PMID:23658023.title: Comparative proteomic analysis of supportive and unsupportive extracellular matrix substrates for human embryonic stem cell maintenance.

assessment.review_notes: Selected Methods/Results and original XML Table1 row11 were checked. COL1A2 occurs in several substrate columns including feeder-free HUES1 ECM (normalized count18.1); human and mouse feeder columns are distinguished. The table does not resolve every processed product.

PMID:25037231.title: Extracellular matrix signatures of human primary metastatic colon cancers and their metastases to liver.

assessment.review_notes: Selected Methods/Results and both authentic supplemental sheets row97 were read. The P08123/B4DN66/B4DTF5 group is detected across the human colon/liver preparations. Both sheets repeat the same group and are not independent experiments; no isoform-resolved activity or mechanical property is inferred.

assessment.review_notes: Actual selected Results/Discussion about human stem-cell-derived matrices were read; the exact COL1A2 target-level supplement remains uninspected. Preserve the experimental source without pretending that generic matrix results constitute a new target-specific measurement.

PMID:32095531.title: Broadly conserved roles of TMEM131 family proteins in intracellular collagen assembly and secretory cargo trafficking.

changed_reviews.reason: The positive screen pair is preserved at its source-specific assay scope: the literal records match the 313-aa SGTA O43765 and 1366-aa COL1A2 sequences, with no reported truncation. Independently, original PMID28104892 shows SGTA capturing hydrophobic tail-anchored clients and transferring them through targeting or quality-control modules. Current GO:0051087 covers binding to a chaperone that ensures folding or transport, so this evidence supports the partner-class refinement. SGTA does not insert or ubiquitinate the client by itself. The study did not test COL1A2 as a false-positive control, and its triage mechanism does not negate the separately recorded positive pair. Native processing, endogenous colocalization and a collagen-client pathway remain unestablished; none is being added as a process or core function. See the public source index followup2_4928 for exact assay records, sequence hashes, current definition and original assay locators.

The positive HuRI pair matches the 357-aa human EIF3F sequence. Independently, original PMID21124883 Results/Figure3A tests GST-tagged full-length human EIF3F and its MPN domain in bacteria coexpressing a ubiquitin-fusion substrate, with GST and active/inactive protease controls. The murine mutant, probe and cellular Notch experiments are separate. Current GO:1990381 defines binding to a ubiquitin-specific protease and gives deubiquitinase binding as an exact synonym; it does not specify active-site contact, a substrate relationship or the mode in which the multifunctional partner is engaged. The positive binary assay and experimentally supported human enzyme class justify this refinement without assigning protease activity, collagen deubiquitination or a Notch mechanism to COL1A2. The normal cache remains abstract-only; the separately accessed original Methods/Results and exact pair/product locators are recorded in the public source index followup2_4928.

The positive human screen records match the 234-aa MESD Q14696 precursor, including its signal peptide; they do not establish the native processed binding species. Independently, PMID15014448 directly tests fly Boca-dependent receptor-module maturation and mouse Mesd rescue in Boca-depleted S2 cells, while the human LRP1 domain is a substrate rather than human MESD. These experiments and curated human MESD function support the conserved chaperone class. Current GO:0051087 identifies that partner class, so the source-specific positive association supports chaperone binding without claiming that MESD folds COL1A2 or that the 2004 experiment was a direct human MESD folding assay. Exact product/record, species and definition evidence is available in the public source index followup2_4928.
